verdict.rationale: PayPal documents its own dispute tooling: Resolution Center lets merchants view, monitor and manually respond to disputes, and the Disputes API automates dispute actions, with list_disputes and get_dispute supporting lifecycle tracking. The pack never documents submitting structured evidence (documents, tracking proof) against a chargeback, so the core 'respond with structured evidence' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented structured evidence-submission endpoint or fields, documented dispute status lifecycle and stages through to resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution

citations.quote: Resolution Center: A web-based dashboard where you can view, monitor, and manually respond to disputes.
Disputes API: A programmatic interface that enables you to automate dispute management actions directly from your systems.
disputes (`list_disputes`, `get_dispute`, `accept_dispute_claim` — "Accept a dispute claim, resolving it in favor of the buyer")
